source.page_or_item: Thirtieth annual report of the United States Civil Service Commission for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1913, printed page 133 as cited by WPA, PDF page 133

clauses.text:
October 30, 1913.
Charles J. Brown may be reinstated as a clerk in the classified service of the Treasury
Department without observance of the rules regarding reinstatement after the expira-
tion of one year from date of separation from the service.
This order is recommended by the Secretary of the Treasury in view of Mr. Brown's
former efficient service in that department.
